summary: The Playwright test imports correctly, compiles, and uses Playwright APIs properly. The testCaseId is preserved in the test title. Selectors use data-test attributes which are robust. The test navigates to the base URL and clicks a product link, followed by an assertion that a product name element is visible. The assertion uses await properly on the locator. No hard-coded waits or placeholder URLs beyond the fixed baseUrl are present. However, the assertion could be improved to validate content not just visibility, and navigation verification is minimal but acceptable for this test case.

issues.description: The test verifies that the product name element is visible but does not assert the correctness of the product details content or page URL after navigation.
issues.recommendation: Enhance assertions to verify the product name text or URL to confirm correct navigation to the specific product detail page.

issues.description: Navigation validation only confirms element visibility on page without verifying URL or page load state.
issues.recommendation: Add assertion to check that the URL contains expected product identifier or wait for a known stable page state.

recommendations: Add assertion for page URL or product name text to strengthen test validity.
Consider extracting base URL and selectors into config or constants for maintainability.
Implement more detailed verification for product details in future test cases.
